data.title: 陈千语 · 拓荒归来的水汽回眸
data.description: 高强度拓荒任务结束后，基地浴室的水蒸气弥漫开来。洗去满身风尘的千语披着宽松素雅的墨绿斜襟居家居服，未完全擦干的发丝贴在白皙修长的后颈上。水汽氤氲中她回过头，向来干练锋芒的眼眸此刻泛着罕见的温软水润。
data.action: drying neck with towel, turning around through steam, soft gaze
data.lighting: diffuse warm fluorescent lights through dense steam
data.promptProse: Stepping out from a hot shower at the forward operating base, Chen Qianyu wears a loose dark green linen tunic. Damp black hair clings to the nape of her neck as she looks back through the misty steam with softened, affectionate eyes.
data.animaCaption: Qianyu looking back through refreshing shower steam at the outpost base.
